Codex (OpenAI): which KYA replays were tested

Replays tested on Codex (OpenAI)

No replay has run on Codex (OpenAI). All 51 replays ran on Claude Code only, so this page makes no claim about Codex (OpenAI).

What the Codex (OpenAI) setup page says about coverage

On the MCP path, Codex decides which tools go through MCP; anything it executes natively is outside that path. The plugin hook sees native tool calls too, but it is advisory: it records them and blocks the never-list and the guard pack. The config inherits your key from the environment. Never paste a live key into the TOML.

Source: the Codex (OpenAI) recipe.

Install

The plugin for Codex (OpenAI):

codex plugin marketplace add The-Pixel-Boys/shield-kya
codex plugin add kya@shield-kya

For any host:

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
